messages:
alice_m: Heads-up — I want to roll out the new client-side gating header for SDK routing next week. Need quick sync on backcompat + canary plan. TL;DR: header-based flag + min-version enforcement in server. Thoughts?

ben_j: +1. We should be explicit about fail-open vs fail-closed. If older SDKs don't send the header, should the server assume `off`?

claire_p: My vote: fail-safe = treat missing header as the feature OFF by default. We can opt-in tenants gradually. But also allow a server-side override for org admins.

nikhil_r: Agree with claire. Also propose a `min_client_version` check in the header so server can decide to allow/deny. Example header: `X-Redwood-Feature: new_routing=on;min_sdk=1.4.0`.

alice_m: Nice. Here's a sketch of what the SDK will send automatically when >= 1.4.0:```
X-Redwood-Feature: new_routing=on;min_sdk=1.4.0;canary_id=blue-123
```If SDK version < 1.4.0 it sends nothing.

sara_ops: How do we detect canary audience? We should support percentage rollouts and tenant whitelists. Server should evaluate header + tenant id + rollout config.

ben_j: For percentages we already have server-side bucketing based on customer_id. So header can carry `canary_id` or `force=true` for QA. Otherwise use server rules.

claire_p: One risk: a buggy SDK that sets the header incorrectly. Suggest server validate semver string with a small lib and if parsing fails, treat as missing. Also emit telemetry metric `sdk.header.parse_failure`.

nikhil_r: +1. Add guardrail: if more than 0.5% of requests start erroring with the new routing, auto-toggle off for that model variant and alert on-call. Implement a short-circuit kill switch.

alice_m: Proposed rollout steps: 1) Release SDK 1.4.0 with header + feature flag logic behind dev toggle. 2) Canary to internal dogfood tenants (5%) for 24h. 3) Canary to 5% external traffic for 48h. 4) Expand to 25% then 100% if metrics OK. 5) Finalize server-side default to OFF for legacy SDKs.

ben_j: That sequence looks good. For step 2/3 we should add a `--smoke` test in CI that verifies header presence for instrumented SDKs and a quick traffic replay job.

claire_p: QA checklist: 
- Verify header format for 1.4.0 on Linux/mac/JS runtimes
- Backcompat: app with 1.3.x should behave same as today
- Ensure server-side fallback is OFF for missing header
- Validate telemetry (success rate, latency, error spikes)

nikhil_r: I opened a PR with SDK changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2201 Please review. It toggles header behavior under `flags.new_routing` config and adds `X-Redwood-Feature` emission.

alice_m: Ping @ben_j @claire_p for review on that PR. We need reviews today to keep to the timeline. :eyes:

ben_j: Reviewing now. Quick nit: use `;` separators not `,` to avoid CSV parsing issues. Also include `sdk_platform=js|py` in header.

claire_p: Also add a metric tag `sdk_version` on the server side so we can group by client version.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment created for `new-routing` model variant (canary_id=blue-123) — env: staging — traffic: 5% — started at 2024-11-21T14:22:10Z.

sara_ops: For emergencies: add a toggle in Console -> Feature flags to instantly disable at org or global level. Also document rollback steps in runbook.

alice_m: We'll add a runbook snippet to the PR. Example emergency command: `rctl features set new_routing --org all --state off --reason "rollout emergency"`.

ben_j: One more note: avoid coupling SDK header parsing to production logic. Server should never trust header alone for critical security decisions — always validate with internal config.

claire_p: Agreed. Final checklist for merge: PR approvals (2), unit tests for header encoding/decoding, e2e smoke verifying server interprets missing header as OFF, docs update in /docs/feature-gates.md.

nikhil_r: I'll add tests and the docs updates today. Plan to cut 1.4.0 rc by EOD if reviews land.

alice_m: Thanks all. If anything blocks, drop updates here. I'll start the rollout calendar + JIRA ticket. :thumbsup:
